---
title: "Receipt Processor"
---

Welcome to the Receipt Processor documentation site. This project helps you extract structured information from receipt images and text, store results in a database, and analyze spending by vendor, category, and time.

## Navigate This Site

-   **Tutorial** — Start with the [Tutorial](tutorial.qmd) for step-by-step installation, environment setup, and guided examples.
-   **Documentation** — Explore the [API reference](api.qmd) to learn which package functions are available and how to use them.
-   **Technical Report** — Read the [Technical Report](technical-report.qmd) for project motivation, data preparation, analysis, and limitations.

## Quick Start

1.  Visit the **Tutorial** to set up your Python environment and install dependencies.
2.  Run the Streamlit app with `streamlit run app.py` to interactively upload receipts and inspect extracted data.
3.  Use the **Documentation** page for function references and integration examples.

## What This Project Includes

-   OCR-based text extraction for receipt images
-   Receipt parsing and structured data extraction
-   SQLite database support for receipts, items, budgets, and analytics
-   A Streamlit app interface for uploading receipts and reviewing results
-   Guided tutorials, API reference documentation, and a technical report

## Need Help?

If you are new to Receipt Processor, start with the [Tutorial](tutorial.qmd). If you want code usage examples, open the [Documentation](api.qmd). For the research context and dataset story, read the [Technical Report](technical-report.qmd).

> Use the site navbar to move between Home, Documentation, Tutorial, and Technical Report.
